newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Nov 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Wall Street Journal - Nov 27.

text.p: Virgin Express is talking with Boeing Co about maybe buying 25 737-700 jetliners valued at $1.1 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday.
- The Federal Trade Commission began investigating television commercials for alcoholic beverages especially those for Seagram Co Ltd and Stroh.
- Shippers, ports and Congress oppose attempts by CSX Corp and Norfolk Southern Corp to buy Conrail Inc .
- OPEC shows no sign of lowering world oil prices.
- Walt Disney Co saw its quarterly profits rise 27 percent.
- Investors have put more than $200 billion into stock mutual funds so far this year.
- U.S. productivity might have risen half a percentage point a year more than the government had believed during the last 20 years.
- IBM Corp will buy back $3.5 billion worth of its common stock.
- Bell Atlantic Corp will pay another $200 million to assume control of Mexican cellular phone company Grupo Iusacell.
- Short interest rose 1.05 percent in stocks on the NASDAQ Stock Market for the month ended November 15.
- A judge cleared the way for a trial in General Motors Corp's case against corporate espionage.
- Japanese life insurers are starting to buy foreign bonds at a quickening pace.
-The FTC expanded its antitrust investigation of PacifiCare Health Systems Inc's $2 billion pact to buy FHP.
- Samsung agreed to pay $1 billion to Texas Instruments Inc over the next 10 years to settle a patent dispute.
